name: API Security Testing
description: Security testing of web APIs including REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and SOAP. Covers endpoint enumeration, input validation, authentication/authorization at the API layer, rate limiting, mass assignment, BOLA/BFLA, and API specification analysis.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to API security testing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands API architectures and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain REST, GraphQL, and SOAP architectures
Familiar with the OWASP API Security Top 10
Understands API authentication mechanisms (API keys, OAuth, JWT)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Tests APIs under supervision using proxy tools and API clients
evidence: Intercepted and manipulated API requests using Burp Suite or similar
Tested for BOLA (broken object-level authorization) in lab environments
Performed supervised API testing on at least 2 engagements

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently tests APIs for OWASP API Top 10 vulnerabilities
evidence: Identifies BOLA, BFLA, mass assignment, and broken object property level authorization (excessive data exposure)
Tests GraphQL APIs for introspection leaks, batching attacks, and injection
Passed proficiency assessment on API security testing

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Tests complex API ecosystems; develops custom testing automation
evidence: Tests microservice architectures and inter-service API trust boundaries
Develops custom Burp extensions or scripts for API testing automation
Reviews OpenAPI/Swagger specifications for security gaps
Mentors junior testers on API security methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on API security; develops methodology and tooling
evidence: Published research or CVEs related to API security flaws
Developed the lab's API testing methodology and tooling
Tests novel API protocols (gRPC, WebSocket, server-sent events) at depth
Trains teams on advanced API security testing

assessment_methods.description: Test a REST and GraphQL API for OWASP API Top 10 vulnerabilities in a lab environment
Review of API security findings from 3 recent engagement reports
